telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.description: Receive a short alert on iPhone and Android when an agent finishes and is waiting for you. Conversation content is not sent.
telegram.desktopOnly: Configure Telegram in the installed Agentdeck app.
telegram.createBotHint: 1. Open BotFather in Telegram, send /newbot and follow the steps to create your bot. Then paste the token below.
telegram.savedTokenPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the saved token
telegram.tokenHint: Treat the token as a password. It is saved securely on this computer and is not included in exported settings.
telegram.startHint: 2. Open {{bot}} using the button below and tap Start in Telegram. Then return here to confirm. This link expires in 10 minutes.
telegram.enabledHint: Send an alert when a response is complete and the agent is waiting for your next instruction.
telegram.masterDisabled: Turn on Notifications above to receive automatic Telegram alerts. You can still configure the bot and send a test.
telegram.reconnectHint: Use the saved token or paste a new one. Then open the new pairing link in the Telegram account that should receive alerts.
telegram.paired: Telegram connected. Turn on the switch to receive completion alerts.
telegram.testSent: Test message sent. Check Telegram on your phone.
telegram.disconnected: Telegram disconnected and the saved token was removed.
telegram.deliveryHint: The computer must stay on, with Agentdeck open and internet access. Allow Telegram notifications on your phone.
telegram.errors.invalidToken: Enter a valid bot token from BotFather.
telegram.errors.unauthorized: Telegram rejected the token. Reconnect with the current token from BotFather.
telegram.errors.network: Could not reach Telegram. Check your internet connection and try again.
telegram.errors.timeout: Telegram took too long to respond. Try again.
telegram.errors.api: Telegram could not complete the request. Try again shortly.
telegram.errors.forbidden: The bot cannot send messages to this conversation. Unblock it in Telegram and reconnect.
telegram.errors.rateLimited: Telegram is receiving too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
telegram.errors.conflict: Another app is using this bot. Create a dedicated bot for Agentdeck in BotFather.
telegram.errors.webhookConfigured: This bot is connected to another service. Create a dedicated bot for Agentdeck in BotFather.
telegram.errors.invalidResponse: Telegram returned an unexpected response. Try again.
telegram.errors.responseTooLarge: Telegram returned an unexpected response. Try again.
telegram.errors.pairingExpired: The pairing link expired. Connect again to get a new link.
telegram.errors.pairingNotFound: Open the bot using the pairing button, tap Start in Telegram and then confirm again here.
telegram.errors.pairingBusy: A connection is already in progress. Wait a moment and try again.
telegram.errors.notConfigured: Connect your Telegram bot before sending a test or enabling alerts.
telegram.errors.storage: Could not save the Telegram settings on this computer. Try again.
telegram.errors.secureStorage: Secure storage is unavailable. Unlock your computer's credential store and try again.
telegram.errors.disabled: Turn on notifications to receive automatic alerts.
telegram.errors.internal: Could not complete the Telegram request. Try again.
telegram.errors.openLink: Could not open Telegram. Check that your browser or Telegram app is available.
session.renameHint: Up to 120 characters. Your chosen name is kept when you send messages or reopen the app.
app.title: Agentdeck
app.split.emptyOtherWorkspace: The open terminal belongs to another workspace. Switch back to that workspace, or open a session from the left sidebar again.
app.split.emptyPickSession: Open a session from the left list to show PTY details in the center.
knowledge.title: Local knowledge
knowledge.description: Choose a Markdown folder or Obsidian vault. Relevant notes are added to prompts on this device.
knowledge.localOnly: Search stays local. Only relevant excerpts are sent to the agent with your task, never the entire vault.
agents.title: Agents
agents.auth.claude-code: Sign in with your Claude account in the official Claude Code CLI. Agentdeck reuses that local login.
agents.auth.codex: Sign in with your ChatGPT account in the official Codex CLI. Agentdeck reuses that local login.
agents.auth.gemini: Sign in with your Google account in Gemini CLI. Agentdeck reuses that local login.
settings.title: Settings
settings.layoutOptions.original.label: Original layout
settings.layoutOptions.original.descript: The menu and terminal detail are shown separately. Expanding a terminal overlays the main content.
settings.layoutOptions.split.label: Split layout
settings.layoutOptions.split.description: Keep the menu visible on the left and show the active terminal detail on the right.

settings.components.usage.label: Usage widget
settings.components.usage.description: Show or hide the usage widget on the right side.
settings.locale.title: Language
settings.locale.description: Choose the interface language. Your selection is saved across restarts.
settings.terminal.fontSizeDescription: Adjust the display size for PTY / CLI terminals.
